name: Sage
description: Runs, evaluates and improves AI agents from task feedback, keeping each version with its evidence, via a desktop app, a self-hosted server API or a Python SDK.

skills.name: Improve agents with RSI
skills.description: Runs an agent on a goal or curated usage history, grades each run with an independent evaluator and keeps tuned versions for you to adopt.

skills.name: Package agent versions
skills.description: Defines an agent's instructions, Skills, tools and resources in sage.yaml and keeps each candidate version with its diff and evaluation record.

skills.name: Compose tools and MCP
skills.description: Combines native tools, reusable Skills and MCP services in one agent, with the host managing authorization and tool policies.

skills.name: Pause and resume runs
skills.description: Persists sessions, streams output, and pauses a run for human input or approval before resuming it.

skills.name: Serve agents over A2A
skills.description: Answers other agents over the A2A protocol at /a2a/v1 and serves an Agent Card, with Bearer API keys scoped to read or invoke.
